hooks.command: UPSTREAM=$(git rev-parse --abbrev-ref --symbolic-full-name @{u} 2>/dev/null || echo origin/main); MERGE_BASE=$(git merge-base HEAD "$UPSTREAM" 2>/dev/null); if [ -z "$MERGE_BASE" ]; then exit 0; fi; MATCHED=$(git diff --name-only "$MERGE_BASE" HEAD | grep -E '^apps/backend/.*(auth|session|password)|(^|/)field_acquisition\.py$|^pyproject\.toml$|^uv\.lock$|package\.json$|package-lock\.json$|^\.env' || true); if [ -n "$MATCHED" ]; then FILES=$(echo "$MATCHED" | tr '\n' ',' | sed 's/,/, /g; s/, $//'); printf '{"hookSpecificOutput":{"hookEventName":"PreToolUse","permissionDecision":"ask","permissionDecisionReason":"This push touches security/secrets/dependency-sensitive files: %s. Run the security-audit skill in guidance mode against these files first (see TESTING.md Security-audit gate section) before confirming this push."}}\n' "$FILES"; fi
hooks.statusMessage: Checking diff for security-sensitive changes before push...
